rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for addressing one person, whether they are the subject or object.

example.jyutping: nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3

rows.note: Use this instead of 你 when addressing two or more people, whether they are the subject or object.

example.english: You come in and have a seat.
example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 jap6 lei4 zo6 laa1

rows.note: Use this for singular “yourself” when the person addressed is the reflexive object.

example.jyutping: nei5 zi6 gei2 cyu2 lei5 laa1

rows.note: Use this for plural “yourselves” when the people addressed are the reflexive object.

example.english: You should take care of yourselves.
example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 zi6 gei2 bou2 zung6 aa3
